title: Become a Data Analyst
description: Go from spreadsheets to SQL, R and dashboards, ending with a portfolio-ready professional certificate.
goal: Get job-ready for entry-level data analyst roles

steps.title: Get comfortable with statistics
steps.note: Averages, spread and probability are the language every later analysis is written in.

steps.title: Learn SQL basics
steps.note: Most analyst work starts with pulling data out of a database, so SQL comes before any tooling.

steps.title: Learn the full analysis workflow
steps.note: With stats and SQL in hand, this certificate ties cleaning, analysis and Tableau dashboards into one process.

steps.title: Add Python and Excel depth
steps.note: A second certificate adds Python and advanced Excel, which many job postings ask for alongside SQL.

steps.title: Go further with R
steps.note: Useful if you enjoyed the R part of the Google certificate and want stronger data wrangling skills.

title: Become a Web Developer
description: Learn JavaScript, build real websites, add Git and React, and finish by shipping full-stack apps.
goal: Build and deploy complete web applications on your own

steps.title: Learn JavaScript fundamentals
steps.note: JavaScript is the one language every browser runs, so it is the foundation for everything after.

steps.title: Use version control with Git
steps.note: Learning Git early means every project from here on is tracked, backed up and shareable.

steps.title: Build full websites
steps.note: A project-based bootcamp that combines HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node and databases into working sites.

steps.title: Build front ends with React
steps.note: Once plain JavaScript feels natural, React is the most requested framework for modern front ends.

steps.title: Understand JavaScript deeply
steps.note: Closures, prototypes and the event loop explained, which makes debugging React apps far easier.

steps.title: Ship full-stack apps
steps.note: A capstone-style course where you design, build and deploy larger apps with Django and JavaScript.

title: Become a Machine Learning Engineer
description: Build the Python and math foundations, learn classic machine learning, then train and understand deep neural networks.
goal: Train, evaluate and ship machine learning models

steps.title: Learn Python properly
steps.note: Every ML library is used from Python, so solid programming skills come first.

steps.title: Learn the math behind ML
steps.note: Linear algebra and calculus explain what models actually optimize, before you start using them.

steps.title: Learn core machine learning
steps.note: Andrew Ng's specialization covers regression, classification and best practices that everything else builds on.

steps.title: Move on to deep learning
steps.note: Neural networks, CNNs and sequence models are the natural next step after classic ML.

steps.title: Train real models end to end
steps.note: A top-down, hands-on course that turns theory into deployed models on real data.

steps.title: Build neural nets from scratch
steps.note: Coding backpropagation and a small GPT yourself is the best way to truly understand modern models.

title: Become a UI/UX Designer
description: Learn how to research users, sketch and prototype in Figma, and build a design portfolio.
goal: Build a portfolio for junior UI/UX designer roles

steps.title: Learn UX foundations
steps.note: A short, free-to-audit introduction to the UX process and the vocabulary used in every later step.

steps.title: Practise design thinking
steps.note: Builds the habit of framing problems and iterating quickly before you open any design tool.

steps.title: Research users and wireframe
steps.note: Covers personas, user research, wireframing and usability testing, the core of day-to-day UX work.

steps.title: Get hands-on with Figma
steps.note: A quick guided project so you are fluent in the industry-standard tool before the big certificate.

steps.title: Build a portfolio
steps.note: The certificate ends with three portfolio projects, which is what hiring managers ask to see.

steps.title: Strengthen visual design
steps.note: Typography, colour and composition make your UI work look as good as it functions.

title: Become a Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Start from IT fundamentals, learn how attacks and defences work, and earn an entry-level security certificate.
goal: Get job-ready for entry-level security analyst roles

steps.title: Learn IT fundamentals
steps.note: Networking, operating systems and troubleshooting are what you will be defending, so learn them first.

steps.title: Understand security concepts
steps.note: A free, approachable overview of threats, encryption and secure practices before going hands-on.

steps.title: Learn analyst skills
steps.note: Covers SIEM tools, Linux, SQL and incident response, the daily toolkit of a security analyst.

steps.title: Think like an attacker
steps.note: Practising real attacks in a lab shows you what the defensive tools are looking for.

title: Become a Cloud & DevOps Engineer
description: Learn Git, AWS, containers and CI/CD, and finish with an AWS associate-level architecture course.
goal: Deploy and operate applications in the cloud

steps.title: Master version control
steps.note: All infrastructure and pipelines live in Git repositories, so this comes before anything else.

steps.title: Learn cloud basics on AWS
steps.note: A free overview of core AWS services, pricing and security that the later steps assume.

steps.title: Package apps with containers
steps.note: Docker and Kubernetes are how modern apps are shipped, and every DevOps role expects them.

steps.title: Automate with CI/CD
steps.note: Ties Git, containers and testing together into automated build and deployment pipelines.

steps.title: Design cloud architectures
steps.note: The final step prepares you for the AWS associate exam and designing systems end to end.

title: Become a Project Manager
description: Learn project management basics, earn a recognised certificate and prepare for the PMP track.
goal: Get job-ready for entry-level project coordinator and manager roles

steps.title: Learn project management basics
steps.note: A free primer on scope, schedules and stakeholders to check the field is right for you.

steps.title: Earn a project management certificate
steps.note: Covers traditional and Agile methods with realistic artefacts you can show employers.

steps.title: Prepare for the PMP track
steps.note: An introduction to the PMP framework, the certification most senior project roles ask for later.

steps.title: Understand the business side
steps.note: Finance, marketing and operations basics help you talk to the people who sponsor your projects.

title: Become a Digital Marketer
description: Learn the digital marketing basics, then go deep on e-commerce, social media and campaign design.
goal: Plan and run digital marketing campaigns

steps.title: Learn digital marketing basics
steps.note: A free overview of SEO, social, email and paid channels before you specialise.

steps.title: Run campaigns and online stores
steps.note: Google's certificate covers campaign measurement and e-commerce with hands-on projects.

steps.title: Specialise in social media
steps.note: Social platforms are where most campaigns run, and Meta's certificate covers paid ads in depth.

steps.title: Broaden your channel skills
steps.note: Fills gaps in areas like YouTube, copywriting and analytics once the core certificates are done.

steps.title: Design your own creatives
steps.note: Being able to make your own ad visuals saves time and money on small teams.
